title: Add new release repositories protobuf_comm and clips_executive
author: TarikViehmann
body:

comments.author: TarikViehmann
comments.body:
Quick question: the `clips_executive` project requires the `protobuf_comm` library, the latter built successfully,but my clips_executive project fails to build as protobuf_comm is not found (i guess because it is not released yet).
Is there anything I can to to make the clips_executive project build already? Or can the `protobuf_comm` project already get the release repository so that the other project can build?
